verdict.rationale: Stripe's docs say ACP is open source under Apache 2.0 and that any business can implement the specification. A runtime probe confirmed MPP's full spec index, with governance pages, is served openly at mpp.dev to a plain unauthenticated GET, and a community comment notes MPP was submitted to the IETF. Neither spec requires signing anything to read. ChatGPT listing and ACS seller connections are gated, but those govern participation, not access to the specs. Missing for 10: explicit evidence that the specs are versioned (only SDK package versions are shown), evidence of an openly published UCP spec, and independent hands-on implementation of a spec without Stripe.
